sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-03 20:00 and 2016-12-03 20:30, 4 transaction(s) totalling $1,880.16 were made on card(s) C06881-K1 belonging to customer C06881. The activity comprised 4 online transaction(s) under product code(s) C, in billing region 327. Online transactions came from device profile(s) iOS Device | iOS 11.2.2 | mobile safari 11.0 | 2208x1242. The purchases were placed within minutes of each other, each just below a $500 threshold, a pattern that avoids single-transaction limits. The same burst shape was found on 12 cards of 12 different customers in the preceding 30 days, indicating coordinated abuse (policy R9). The amount exceeds the $1,000 reporting threshold. Total suspicious amount: $1,880.16. Actions recommended: BLOCK_CARD, CREATE_CASE, FILE_REPORT, ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST.
